labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Dockershim is completely removed from the kubelet, so clusters relying on Docker as the runtime must migrate to a CRI-compliant runtime.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Zone label handling moved to KCM and vSphere clusters using secret-stored credentials must allow kube-system:vsphere-legacy-cloud-provider to update node objects, which is required config work for those users.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The feature gate is enabled by default, so Secret-based service account tokens are no longer auto-generated and workloads depending on them must switch to TokenRequest or create Secrets manually.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Topology spread skew now excludes nodes not matching node affinity, which can make previously schedulable pods unschedulable and requires reviewing constraints.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The deprecated kubelet flag --experimental-check-node-capabilities-before-mount is removed, so scripts or manifests using it must be updated.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: kubeadm.k8s.io/v1beta2 is deprecated with removal only planned for a future release, so it still works and the item notes a migration command without requiring action now.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: kubeadm now defaults to the containerd socket and errors when multiple sockets exist, so configuration files that reference the dockershim socket must be updated.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The feature gate name changed from csiMigrationRBD to CSIMigrationRBD, so users who configured the old spelling must reconfigure it.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The experimental dynamic log sanitization feature is removed and no longer available, so any configuration using it will break.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: kubeadm changes the control plane node label and taint (adding control-plane taint, removing master label), and the item explicitly says infrastructure must be adapted to these changes.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: Service.spec.loadBalancerIP is deprecated but still functions, and the item only encourages annotations with no required action in this release.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: The --master-count flag and master-count reconciler are deprecated in favor of the lease reconciler but still work, so this is a warning only.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The insecure address and port flags are removed, so any deployment still passing them to kube-apiserver will fail to start.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The UnversionedKubeletConfigMap feature gate is enabled by default, changing ConfigMap and RBAC naming on upgrade, which can affect existing tooling and requires overrides to keep legacy behavior.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The tolerate-unready-endpoints Service annotation is removed, so Services still using it will no longer get that behavior and must switch to publishNotReadyAddresses.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The deprecated feature gates ValidateProxyRedirects and StreamingProxyRedirects are removed, so configurations referencing them will be rejected.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Insecure serving configuration is removed from the cloud-provider package, which affects cloud-controller-managers that rely on it.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: The --pod-infra-container-image kubelet flag is deprecated with removal only in future releases, so it still works today and requires no action now.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The client.authentication.k8s.io/v1alpha1 ExecCredential API is removed, so client-go credential plugins using v1alpha1 will stop working and must migrate to v1.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The node.k8s.io/v1alpha1 RuntimeClass API is no longer served, so manifests or clients using it must move to node.k8s.io/v1.
